Re-reviewed revised 30611/30612 all languages: Haldex steering guide p.1 documents excess-flow-associated over-steering/road wander; TRW steering diagnostics discusses gear adjustment and abnormal responses. Learner copy preserves VERO, explicitly discloses unresolved causal link, and does not equate excessive/abnormal steering response with tyre-related dynamics. No positive proof of the 30612 mechanism was found; accepted as a transparent source-qualified explanation, not a proven verdict. Other rows unchanged from full review.

issues.reason: The official item states that failure to change oil at the scheduled interval can cause the oil-pressure warning and marks it FALSO. The technical sources describe an indirect possible chain from irregular oil changes to deposits and from sludge or deposits to low oil pressure. It is unclear whether the quiz intends only the missed date as a direct trigger or excludes this possible indirect cause; the printed verdict cannot safely be reconciled without adjudication.
